# Generated directory

`cargo xtask gen` writes every file in `schema/` and below it, except `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `baseline/`, which has a stub of its own. Don't edit one by hand; run the generator instead. On a merge conflict in one, take either side and run `cargo xtask gen`. The Generated directories table in `docs/contributing/repo-layout.md` lists every generated path.
